name: Witch Doctor: Umbral Glaive swaps only the active Hex of Malice rank (#5761)
contract: Hex of Malice (chain 801693) is a mana spell, so SpellInfo::IsStackableWithRanks() is true and Player::addSpell never deactivates a lower rank when a higher one is learned: every learned rank stays Active in GetSpellMap(), exactly like the Reclamation chain in witchdoctor-spirit-volley-reclamation-rank-spam.json. AscensionWitchDoctor::SyncReplacements must still restrict the Umbral Glaive swap to the player's single active/highest rank, the same way its Volley branch restricts to the active Reclamation rank via id == KnownRank(player, id). #5761 reports the action bar reverting to a lower Hex of Malice rank after casting Umbral Glaive: without that guard, every known rank (lower and highest) independently registers itself with Player::SetTemporarySpellReplacement while UmbralReady is up, so Player::GetSavedActionButtonSpell can resolve a button through whichever rank last won the unordered_map race instead of the player's actual highest rank.

steps.label: Let login hooks and class synchronisation settle
SETUP: the lower Hex of Malice rank stays known
SETUP: the lower rank stays active, unlike a superseded normal rank
SETUP: the highest learned Hex of Malice rank is known and active
Umbral Glaive Ready retargets the highest Hex of Malice rank
The lower Hex of Malice rank is left untouched
The Umbral Glaive button is saved as the highest Hex of Malice rank
Control: a button on the lower rank is saved unchanged
Casting Umbral Glaive consumes the proc
The action bar reverts to the highest Hex of Malice rank
The saved button still resolves to the highest Hex of Malice rank
